newsitem.title: UK: Eurotherm wary of adverse sterling impact.
newsitem.headline: Eurotherm wary of adverse sterling impact.

text.p: British electronics maker Eurotherm Plc said on Tuesday that if current sterling strength continues it is likely to have an impact on the company's performance in 1997.
"If sterling's current strength continues, this and other effects are likely to have an impact on Eurotherm's performance in 1997," the company told its annual general meeting.
Eurotherm exports, which are primarily headed for continental European markets, amounted to just short of 50 million stg last year.
The company said that as a consequence of the recent increase in the value of the pound the cost to purchasers of its exports has risen so far in this financial year by around 10 percent.
